statements.note: The authors reconstruct the reference cost from Ref. [199]'s Table 2 parameters and its Eq. (12), using 5,650 logical qubits. They report an average spacetime cost of 5.42 × 10^15 qubit·T gates per run across the 500 runs.

statements.note: The block-encoding cost is charged once per query. The size of $\lambda$ determines the leading query count. The $22.53$ Ha per electron–proton or electron–electron pair is a sum over nonzero momentum transfers. The $218\cdot216$ electron–proton pairs and $\binom{218}{2}$ electron pairs account for about $91.4\%$ of the normalization.
